events.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
events.titleJa: Copilot Studio で作成者間のエージェント共有に対応
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
events.summary: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.
events.summaryJa: Copilot Studio の新しい GHCP ハーネスで、作成者間でエージェントを共有できるようになります。自動割り当てのセキュリティ ロールにより、他の作成者へ閲覧者または編集者としてアクセスを付与できます。
events.summaryEn: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.

events.title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Usage reports - Message consumption for Pay-as-you-go experiences in Copilot Chat.
events.titleJa: Microsoft 365 Copilot の会議・チャット機能を更新
events.titleEn: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Usage reports - Message consumption for Pay-as-you-go experiences in Copilot Chat.
events.summary: A new report to help IT admins manage costs for billed messages that are Pay-as-you-go enabled for Copilot Chat. Reporting includes drill down of billed messages per user, per billing policy, per agent-level and agent-user level pair. #copilotcontrolsystem
events.summaryJa: IT 管理者が Copilot Chat に対して従量課金制が有効になっている請求メッセージのコストを管理するのに役立つ新しいレポート。レポートには、ユーザーごと、請求ポリシーごと、エージェント レベルおよびエージェントとユーザー レベルのペアごとの請求メッセージのドリルダウンが含まれます。 #copilotcontrolsystem
events.summaryEn: A new report to help IT admins manage costs for billed messages that are Pay-as-you-go enabled for Copilot Chat. Reporting includes drill down of billed messages per user, per billing policy, per agent-level and agent-user level pair. #copilotcontrolsystem

events.titleEn: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Use bullseye routing with user groups to orchestrate conversations
events.summary: Bullseye routing with user groups enables a tiered assignment strategy that automatically expands the pool of eligible representatives as conversation wait time increases.
